business_summary: Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the aerospace pulverized coal pressurized gasification technology business in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in the research and development, engineering design, technical services, equipment supply, and EPC contracting of coal gasification technology and key equipment; and industrial gas operation business. The company was formerly known as Changzheng Engineering Co.,LTD and changed its name to Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd in October 2023. Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd는 중화인민공화국에서 항공우주 미분탄 가압 가스화 기술 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 석탄 가스화 기술 및 핵심 장비의 연구 개발, 엔지니어링 설계, 기술 서비스, 장비 공급 및 EPC 계약에 참여합니다. 및 산업용 가스 운영 사업. 이 회사는 이전에 Changzheng Engineering Co.,LTD로 알려졌으며 2023년 10월에 Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. Changzheng Engineering Technology Co.,Ltd는 2007년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
